description: Hand-vetted multi-Kit composition recipes for common HarmonyOS app features. A feature-shaped task typically needs several Kits in a defined order; the typed-chaining algorithm can't infer these because the catalog's I/O fields aren't clean type names. The 'when' phrasings are bilingual so the router matches both Chinese and English prompts. 'skills' is ordered: the first is the headline Kit, the rest are supporting.

provenance.authored_by: Claude (LLM-authored from training knowledge + the in-session HarmonyOS work). Several recipes are now lifecycle.status=validated — their Kit bundle is corroborated by a building HarmonyOS sample app under DemoApp/HarmonyOS_NEXT/ that uses exactly those APIs (see each recipe's lifecycle.validated.exemplar); the rest are still draft (LLM-authored, unverified).
provenance.catalog_sdk: HarmonyOS SDK as shipped in skill.zip (API ~12+); reference docs in each Kit's references/ are the source of truth for current API names. The DemoApp exemplars' build-profiles declare HarmonyOS 4.0.0(10) — older than the catalog, but the corroborated APIs (AVPlayer, notificationManager, formProvider, distributedKVStore, ...) are stable through HarmonyOS NEXT.
provenance.policy: Recipes are advisory. The `skills` bundle is curated cross-Kit judgment and is usually right; the API names in `notes` can go stale — always cross-check the headline Kit's current reference docs (run `route --deep` on it) before relying on a recipe's prose. A `validated` recipe has a known good exemplar; bump it to draft if a catalog refresh breaks it (`npm run lint-recipes` catches a removed/renamed Kit). See compositions/RECIPES.md.

compositions.name: 本地数据持久化 / Local data persistence
when: 保存应用数据使其在应用重启后仍可读取 / Persist app data so it survives an app restart
用首选项或数据库保存用户设置、列表和记录 / Save user settings, lists, and records with Preferences or a database
把待办事项、笔记、订单或聊天记录保存到本地 / Save todos, notes, orders, or chat history to local storage
实现本地离线数据存储和增删改查 / Implement local offline data storage with CRUD
compositions.notes: arkdata = the storage API: @ohos.data.preferences for lightweight key-value config, @ohos.data.relationalStore (RDB) for structured records. arkts = the async/await + file handling around it. Add arkui only if you also render the persisted data in the UI.

compositions.name: 带跳转的本地通知 / Local notification with a tap action
when: 给用户发一条本地通知，点击后打开指定页面 / Send a local notification that opens a page when tapped
发布带进度条的下载通知 / Publish a download-progress notification
在某个事件或定时器触发时提醒用户 / Remind the user when an event or timer fires
实现任务到期提醒或后台事件通知 / Implement a task-due reminder or a background-event notification
当一条待办到期时给用户发送提醒通知 / Send a reminder notification when a todo or task is due
添加任务提醒通知，到点弹出并可点击查看 / Add a task-reminder notification that pops up at the due time and is tappable
compositions.notes: notification-kit = NotificationRequest + publish/cancel. ability-kit = the WantAgent that the notification's tap action launches (the target UIAbility/page). arkts = async control. Declare ohos.permission for notifications in module.json5. NOT push-kit (that's server-side/offline cloud delivery).

compositions.name: 网络请求并展示数据 / HTTP fetch then render
when: 从服务器拉取 JSON 数据并在列表中展示 / Fetch JSON from a server and show it in a list
调用 REST API 获取数据并渲染到界面 / Call a REST API and render the result in the UI
实现新闻、商品或动态列表的网络加载 / Load a news / product / feed list over the network
用 http 模块发起 GET/POST 请求并处理响应 / Make GET/POST requests with the http module and handle the response
compositions.notes: network-kit = @ohos.net.http for the request. arkui = List/LazyForEach to render the result. arkts = async/await + the data model. Declare ohos.permission.INTERNET in module.json5.

compositions.name: 桌面服务卡片 / Home-screen service widget
when: 做一个显示应用数据的桌面卡片 / Build a home-screen card that shows app data
实现 ArkTS 服务卡片，支持点击刷新 / Implement an ArkTS service widget with tap-to-refresh
把今日待办或天气展示在桌面小组件上 / Show today's todos or weather on a desktop widget
添加锁屏卡片或互动卡片 / Add a lock-screen card or an interactive card
compositions.notes: form-kit = form_config.json + the FormExtensionAbility lifecycle (onAddForm/onUpdateForm). arkui = the card's declarative UI. ability-kit = the FormExtensionAbility itself and any WantAgent for card actions. Only ONE card may be isDefault:true.

compositions.name: 语音输入 / Voice input
when: 点击麦克风按钮，说话后转成文字填入界面 / Tap a mic button, speak, and put the transcribed text into the UI
实现语音转文字输入功能 / Implement speech-to-text input
用语音口述一条待办或备忘 / Dictate a todo or memo by voice
集成离线或在线语音识别 / Integrate offline or online speech recognition
compositions.notes: core-speech-kit = the SpeechRecognizer (online/offline) API. arkui = the mic button + the text field that receives the result. ability-kit = permission prompt flow if needed. Declare ohos.permission.MICROPHONE in module.json5.

compositions.name: 选图并编辑 / Pick a photo and edit it
when: 让用户从相册选一张图片然后裁剪或调整 / Let the user pick a photo from the gallery, then crop or adjust it
实现图片选择、编辑和保存功能 / Implement photo pick, edit, and save
做一个简单的图片编辑器界面 / Build a simple image-editor screen
用 Picker 选图并用 image 模块处理 / Pick an image with Picker and process it with the image module
compositions.notes: media-library-kit = PhotoViewPicker to select (no broad media permission needed for the picker). image-kit = ImageSource/PixelMap/ImagePacker for decode/edit/encode. arkui = the editor canvas and controls. NOT the removed @ohos.multimedia.mediaLibrary — use photoAccessHelper / the picker.

compositions.name: 后台任务 / Background task
when: 在后台执行长时任务，比如下载、上传或同步数据 / Run a long-running background task such as download, upload, or data sync
应用切到后台后继续运行某个任务直到完成 / Keep a task running after the app goes to background until it finishes
实现延迟任务或定时后台刷新 / Implement a deferred task or a scheduled background refresh
用前台服务通知保持后台进程不被回收 / Use a foreground-service notification to keep a background process alive
添加后台代理提醒（AgentReminder） / Add a background agent reminder (AgentReminder)
compositions.notes: background-tasks-kit = 长时任务 (continuous task — download/upload/sync/audioPlayback; keeps running after the app backgrounds) / 短时任务 (transient task — brief window) / 延迟任务 (deferred WorkScheduler) / 后台代理提醒 (AgentReminder). ability-kit = the WantAgent that startBackgroundRunning(context, BackgroundMode.*, wantAgent) requires — taps on the system-shown ongoing notification open this UIAbility. arkts = the async logic of the task itself (TaskPool/Worker for CPU-heavy work). Add notification-kit only if you want a *custom* progress notification (e.g. a download bar) on top of the system one. Declare ohos.permission.KEEP_BACKGROUND_RUNNING plus the matching backgroundModes in module.json5. NOT a plain setInterval/setTimeout — it's killed when the app suspends.

compositions.name: 跨设备数据同步 / Cross-device data sync
when: 把应用数据在用户的多台设备之间自动同步 / Automatically sync app data across the user's devices
手机和平板共享同一份业务数据 / Share the same business data between phone and tablet
用分布式数据对象在跨端实现数据一致 / Use a distributed data object to keep data consistent across devices
实现跨设备的待办、收藏或进度同步 / Sync todos, favorites, or progress across devices
建立跨设备协同会话并交换数据 / Set up a cross-device collaboration session and exchange data
compositions.notes: arkdata = the data layer that actually syncs: distributed KV-Store / distributed RDB / distributed data object. distributed-service-kit = device discovery + the collaboration session those distributed objects ride on. arkts = the data model + async glue. Declare ohos.permission.DISTRIBUTED_DATASYNC in module.json5. For local-only persistence use the local-persistence recipe; for cloud (not device-to-device) sync use cloud-foundation-kit instead.

compositions.name: 相机拍摄 / Camera capture
when: 在应用内打开相机拍照或录像 / Open the camera in-app to take a photo or record video
做一个自定义相机界面，带预览、对焦、闪光灯 / Build a custom camera screen with preview, focus, and flash
拍照后把图片返回给上层界面处理 / Capture a photo and return it to the calling screen for processing
录制一段视频并保存到应用 / Record a video clip and save it in the app
实现自定义拍摄功能（不是扫码） / Implement custom capture (not code scanning)
compositions.notes: camera-kit = the capture pipeline — camera input + CaptureSession + output streams (preview / photo / video). arkui = the XComponent surface for preview plus the shutter/flash controls. ability-kit = the runtime permission prompt flow. Declare ohos.permission.CAMERA (plus MICROPHONE for video) in module.json5 with reason/usedScene. To just *pick* an existing photo (no live capture) use the photo-pick-and-edit recipe — the picker needs no camera permission. To scan a QR/barcode use the scan-code recipe.

compositions.name: 地图与定位 / Map and location
when: 在界面上显示一张地图并标出当前位置 / Show a map in the UI and mark the current location
获取用户的经纬度并做地理编码/逆地理编码 / Get the user's lat/long and do geocoding / reverse geocoding
在地图上添加标记、画路线或做路径规划 / Add markers, draw routes, or do route planning on a map
实现附近搜索、POI 检索或定位打卡 / Implement nearby search, POI lookup, or a location check-in
持续追踪位置变化，比如运动轨迹 / Continuously track location changes, e.g. an activity track
compositions.notes: map-kit = the MapComponent + markers/overlays/route polylines + geocoding + place (POI) search. location-kit = the position fixes (single or continuous; GNSS/network) and geofencing that feed the map. arkui = the map container and the surrounding controls. Declare ohos.permission.APPROXIMATELY_LOCATION (plus LOCATION, plus LOCATION_IN_BACKGROUND for background tracking) in module.json5 with reason/usedScene.

compositions.name: 安全凭据存储 / Secure credential storage
when: 安全地保存用户密码、Token 或密钥 / Securely store a user password, token, or key
把登录凭据加密存储，避免明文落盘 / Store login credentials encrypted, never plaintext on disk
实现自动登录所需的凭据保管 / Keep the credentials needed for auto-login
需要硬件级保护的敏感数据存储 / Sensitive-data storage with hardware-backed protection
管理应用的关键资产，增删改查 / Manage the app's critical assets — add / query / update / remove
compositions.notes: asset-store-kit = the Asset API — hardware-backed (TEE) storage for short secrets: passwords, tokens, keys; access can be gated on screen-lock state. arkts = the async calls + the data model around it. For ordinary (non-secret) app data use the local-persistence recipe (arkdata). To perform crypto operations (encrypt/sign with managed keys) add universal-keystore-kit. NOT plain Preferences or files for secrets — those are unencrypted.

compositions.name: 分享内容 / Share content
when: 把文本、图片或文件分享到其他应用 / Share text, images, or files to other apps
弹出系统分享面板让用户选择目标应用 / Pop the system share sheet for the user to pick a target app
实现"分享给朋友"或导出到第三方应用 / Implement 'share with a friend' or export to a third-party app
通过 UDMF 把内容传给接收方应用 / Hand content to the receiving app via UDMF
把当前页面内容，如链接或截图，分享出去 / Share the current page's content, such as a link or a screenshot
compositions.notes: share-kit = the system share-sheet API (SharePanel / system share), built on UDMF (Unified Data Management Framework) records. arkui = the trigger (a share button) and any pre-share preview. To *receive* shared content, add ability-kit (the abilities + skills filters in module.json5 that declare what your app accepts). For device-to-device file transfer (not the app share sheet) use service-collaboration-kit / distributed-service-kit instead.

compositions.name: 扫码 / Scan a code
when: 扫描二维码或条形码并拿到结果 / Scan a QR code or barcode and get the result
在应用里加一个扫一扫入口 / Add a 'scan' entry point in the app
用相机识别二维码后跳转或填表 / Recognize a QR code with the camera then navigate or fill a form
调用默认扫码界面或做自定义扫码界面 / Use the default scan UI or build a custom scan screen
从相册图片里识别二维码 / Recognize a QR code from a gallery image
compositions.notes: scan-kit = the scanning API — the default scan UI (scanBarcode) or a customizable scanner component; also decodes codes from a still image. arkui = the scan button + result handling. ability-kit = the camera permission prompt flow. Declare ohos.permission.CAMERA in module.json5 with reason/usedScene. For general in-app camera capture (photos/video, not code scanning) use the camera-capture recipe instead.

compositions.name: 应用内购买 / In-app purchase
when: 在应用内销售数字商品、会员或订阅 / Sell digital goods, memberships, or subscriptions in-app
实现购买流程并校验购买凭据 / Implement the purchase flow and verify the purchase token
查询商品信息、发起支付、处理结果回调 / Query product info, start payment, handle the result callback
做一个解锁高级功能的内购页面 / Build an in-app-purchase screen that unlocks premium features
管理已购项目和补单或恢复购买 / Manage owned items and reconcile or restore purchases
compositions.notes: iap-kit = the IAP API — query products, launch purchase, get/verify the purchase token, handle consumables vs non-consumables vs subscriptions. account-kit = the Huawei-account sign-in that IAP requires. arkui = the store/paywall UI. Verify purchase tokens server-side. For paying *out* / wallet passes (not selling digital goods) use payment-kit / wallet-kit. Requires AppGallery Connect setup.

compositions.name: 深度链接 / Deep linking
when: 处理从外部链接打开应用并跳到指定页面 / Handle opening the app from an external link and routing to a specific page
实现 Deep Linking 或 App Linking / Implement Deep Linking or App Linking
用 Want 传参在应用间跳转 / Pass parameters across apps with a Want
点击短信或网页里的链接直接打开应用对应页面 / Tapping a link in a text or web page opens the matching app page
配置 URI scheme 或 https 域名关联来拉起应用 / Configure a URI scheme or an https domain association to launch the app
compositions.notes: ability-kit = the Want / UIAbility entry that receives the incoming link, the skills filters in module.json5 that declare which URIs/schemes/actions the app handles, and the code that parses the Want's parameters. app-linking-kit = the verified-https-domain App Linking flow (vs. plain Deep Linking's URI scheme). arkts = the routing logic that takes the parsed params to the right page. For *outgoing* links to other apps use ability-kit's startAbility with an explicit or implicit Want.

compositions.name: 音视频播放 / Audio & video playback
when: 在应用里播放一段视频或音频，带播放/暂停/进度条 / Play a video or audio clip in-app with play/pause/seek controls
用 AVPlayer 播放本地文件或网络流 / Use AVPlayer to play a local file or a network stream
做一个简单的视频播放器界面 / Build a simple video-player screen
实现播放进度、倍速、音量和全屏控制 / Implement playback progress, speed, volume, and full-screen controls
compositions.notes: media-kit = AVPlayer — note its strict state machine (idle->initialized->prepared->playing/paused->stopped->released) and the on('stateChange'/'timeUpdate'/'error') events; AVPlayer.fdSrc for a local file fd, .url for a stream. arkui = the Video component (simple) or an XComponent surface (custom render) plus the transport controls. arkts = the async/await around prepare()/play() and the state model. For *recording* (not playback) use the audio-video-recording recipe; for a background music app with lock-screen controls use background-music-player.

compositions.name: 录音录像 / Audio & video recording
when: 在应用里录一段音频或视频并保存成文件 / Record audio or video in-app and save it to a file
用 AVRecorder 录音并写入沙箱文件 / Record audio with AVRecorder and write it to a sandbox file
做一个录音机功能，开始/暂停/停止/保存 / Build a voice-recorder feature with start/pause/stop/save
录制后回放或导出录音文件 / Play back or export the recorded file afterward
compositions.notes: media-kit = AVRecorder — build an AVRecorderConfig (audio/video source, profile, the output file fd via url='fd://'+fd), then prepare()/start()/pause()/stop()/release(); same on('stateChange'/'error') discipline as AVPlayer. core-file-kit = @ohos.file.fs to open the output file and get the fd you hand to the recorder. arkts = the async glue + recorder state model. Declare ohos.permission.MICROPHONE (and CAMERA for video). For *playing back* the result use the media-playback recipe; for live camera capture (preview/photo/video frames) use camera-capture.

compositions.name: 后台音乐播放器 / Background music player
when: 做一个能在后台继续播放的音乐播放器 / Build a music player that keeps playing in the background
在锁屏和控制中心显示播放控制和歌曲信息 / Show playback controls and song info on the lock screen and in Control Center
实现 AVSession 媒体会话，支持系统媒体控件 / Implement an AVSession media session wired to the system media controls
音乐应用：后台播放 + 媒体通知 + 桌面卡片 / Music app: background playback + media notification + a home-screen widget
compositions.notes: avsession-kit = AVSession.createAVSession + setAVMetadata (title/artist/cover) + setAVPlaybackState + the control-command listeners (play/pause/next/prev/seek) that drive lock-screen & Control-Center media controls. media-kit = the AVPlayer that actually decodes the audio. background-tasks-kit = startBackgroundRunning with BackgroundMode.AUDIO_PLAYBACK so playback continues after the app backgrounds. ability-kit = the WantAgent that startBackgroundRunning requires (taps on the system media notification open this UIAbility). Optionally add form-kit for a now-playing home-screen card (as DemoApp/HarmonyOS_NEXT/MusicHome does). Declare ohos.permission.KEEP_BACKGROUND_RUNNING + backgroundModes:['audioPlayback'] in module.json5. For one-off playback without lock-screen controls / background, the media-playback recipe is enough.

compositions.name: 文件选择与管理 / File pick & manage
when: 让用户选一个文件或文档，读写它的内容 / Let the user pick a file or document and read/write its contents
做一个文件管理器界面，浏览、打开、保存文件 / Build a file-manager screen to browse, open, and save files
用 DocumentViewPicker 选文件，用 file.fs 读写 / Pick files with DocumentViewPicker and read/write with file.fs
浏览相册里的图片或保存文件到指定目录 / Browse photos in the gallery or save a file to a chosen directory
compositions.notes: core-file-kit = @ohos.file.picker's DocumentViewPicker (DocumentSelectOptions to pick, DocumentSaveOptions to choose a save location — both return URIs, no broad storage permission needed) plus @ohos.file.fs (open/read/write/stat/close, OpenMode flags, sync + stream APIs) for the file contents. media-library-kit = photoAccessHelper.getPhotoAccessHelper to browse/query images & videos (PhotoType) when the files are media. arkui = the file list / browser UI. For *editing an image* you picked, chain into photo-pick-and-edit (image-kit); for the system share sheet use share-content.

compositions.name: 图片编辑与预览 / Image Editing and Preview
when: 我想做一个能裁剪、旋转、滤镜处理并预览图片的页面 / I want to build a page that crops, rotates, filters, and previews images
需要在 HarmonyOS 应用里读取图片 EXIF 并展示到界面上 / I need to read image EXIF in a HarmonyOS app and show it in the UI
实现图片解码后在自定义组件中显示和编辑 / Decode an image, then display and edit it in a custom component
做一个相册图片处理界面，用户调整后实时刷新预览 / Build a gallery image processing screen where user adjustments refresh the preview in real time
compositions.notes: Image Kit decodes image sources, reads EXIF, and performs image processing or editing to produce updated image data, while ArkUI builds the interactive preview/editing UI and binds state so processed results are rendered back to the screen.

compositions.name: 内嵌网页交互界面 / Embedded Web Interaction UI
when: 我想在应用页面中嵌入并加载网页 / I want to embed and load a web page inside an app screen
需要用原生声明式界面承载 Web 组件 / I need a declarative native UI to host a Web component
希望在 HarmonyOS 应用中实现网页与页面状态联动 / I want a HarmonyOS app where web content interacts with page state
我要做一个带 WebView、网页加载和 JS 交互的页面 / I need a page with WebView-style loading and JavaScript interaction
compositions.notes: ArkUI builds the declarative native page, component layout, and state holders, then ArkWeb provides the embedded Web component that loads web content and exposes web events, JavaScript interaction, and security controls back to the ArkUI page state.

compositions.name: 文件存储与备份 / File Storage and Backup
when: 我需要在应用沙箱中创建、读取、修改和删除文件 / I need to create, read, update, and delete files in the app sandbox
我想让用户选择本地文件并导入到应用中 / I want users to select local files and import them into the app
我需要管理图片、文档或新闻稿等应用生成的文件 / I need to manage app-generated files such as images, documents, or news drafts
我想实现应用数据的备份与恢复 / I want to implement app data backup and restore
compositions.notes: core-file-kit provides the file access, app-file/user-file management, and backup/restore capabilities; the app reads or writes file data through this Kit, then reuses the same stored data for editing, publishing, or recovery flows.

compositions.name: 基础服务操作界面 / Basic Services Action UI
when: 我想做一个页面，让用户复制内容到剪贴板并显示操作结果 / I want to build a page where users copy content to the clipboard and see the operation result
需要在应用里提供文件上传、下载入口，并用界面展示进度或状态 / I need upload and download entry points in the app with UI showing progress or status
想实现一个文件压缩功能，并在页面上触发和反馈压缩结果 / I want to implement file compression triggered from a page with result feedback
需要把剪贴板、文件上传下载、压缩这些基础能力封装成可交互组件 / I need to wrap clipboard, file upload/download, and compression basics into interactive components
compositions.notes: ArkUI builds the declarative screens, buttons, state, and feedback components; Basic Services Kit performs clipboard, file upload/download, or compression actions triggered by the UI, then returns status or result data for ArkUI to render.

compositions.name: 本地数据驱动服务卡片 / Local Data-Driven Service Widgets
when: 我想把应用里的本地数据展示到桌面服务卡片上 / I want to show local app data in a home-screen service widget
需要服务卡片读取 Preferences 或 KV 数据并保持更新 / I need a service widget to read Preferences or KV data and stay updated
应用启动后保存用户状态，再让卡片展示最新状态 / Save user state after app launch and display the latest state in the widget
为健康、音乐、电影等场景做可持久化的 ArkTS 卡片 / Build a persistent ArkTS widget for health, music, movie, or similar scenarios
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the application lifecycle entry points, ArkData persists app state through Preferences, KV storage, or relational data, and Form Kit renders that stored state as an ArkTS service card. The typical flow is UIAbility or AbilityStage writes/updates local data, then the FormExtension/card logic reads the data and refreshes the desktop or lock-screen card UI.

compositions.name: 本地图片编辑与保存 / Local Image Editing and Saving
when: 我想从应用或用户文件中读取图片，编辑后再保存 / I want to read an image from app or user files, edit it, and save it back
需要实现本地图片裁剪、旋转或滤镜处理，并管理输出文件 / Need local image crop, rotate, or filter processing with output file management
如何解析图片 EXIF 信息并把修改后的图片写入文件 / How to parse image EXIF metadata and write the edited image to a file
做一个离线图片编辑器，支持打开、处理和保存图片 / Build an offline image editor that can open, process, and save images
compositions.notes: Core File Kit locates, opens, reads, writes, and persists image files from app or user storage; Image Kit consumes the file data for decoding, EXIF reading, image processing/editing, and encoding, then returns encoded image bytes or metadata updates for Core File Kit to save.

compositions.name: 应用UI与生命周期自动化测试 / App UI and Lifecycle Automated Testing
when: 我想为HarmonyOS应用的页面和组件编写单元测试与UI测试 / I want to write unit and UI tests for HarmonyOS app pages and components
如何测试UIAbility启动后的界面状态和交互流程 / How can I test UI state and interaction flows after a UIAbility starts
需要给ArkUI声明式组件添加自动化测试用例 / I need to add automated test cases for ArkUI declarative components
想验证登录页等应用页面的渲染、点击和状态变化是否正确 / I want to verify rendering, taps, and state changes on app pages such as a login screen
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the app entry and lifecycle under test, ArkTS implements the app logic and test code, ArkUI renders the declarative components and state that tests interact with, and Test Kit drives unit, UI, or performance test execution against those Ability and UI surfaces.

compositions.name: 媒体库资源管理 / Media Library Asset Management
when: 需要从系统相册选择图片或视频并读取媒体信息 / Need to pick images or videos from the system album and read media metadata
需要把编辑后的图片保存回相册 / Need to save edited images back to the photo album
需要将录制生成的视频写入媒体库并管理相册 / Need to write recorded videos to the media library and manage albums
需要浏览、查询、创建或删除照片和视频资源 / Need to browse, query, create, or delete photo and video assets
compositions.notes: Media Library Kit provides album, photo, and video asset access and management; the app queries or selects existing media from the library, processes or records content, then creates or updates the resulting media asset back in the library.

compositions.name: 后台数据持久化 / Background Data Persistence
when: 我想在后台任务中定期保存计步、闹钟或播放状态 / I want to periodically save step counts, alarms, or playback state from a background task
应用退到后台后仍需执行任务并把结果写入本地数据库 / The app needs to keep running work in the background and write results to local storage
需要用延迟或短时后台任务同步本地偏好设置和KV数据 / I need delayed or short background tasks to sync local preferences and KV data
后台采集的数据要持久化，前台页面下次打开时继续读取 / Data collected in the background must be persisted and read again when the UI is reopened
compositions.notes: background-tasks-kit schedules or runs short, long, or delayed background work, and arkdata persists the task output as Preferences, KV records, or relational database rows for later foreground use.

compositions.name: 持久化提醒通知 / Persistent Reminder Notifications
when: 需要保存闹钟或健康目标，并在到点时发送本地通知 / Save alarms or health goals and send local notifications when due
想把用户设置存到本地，然后根据设置展示通知、角标或进度通知 / Store user preferences locally and show notifications, badges, or progress notifications based on them
需要应用重启后仍能恢复待提醒事项并继续通知用户 / Restore pending reminders after app restart and continue notifying the user
想记录步数、习惯或任务进度，并用通知提醒或展示进度 / Record steps, habits, or task progress and surface reminders or progress through notifications
compositions.notes: ArkData persists user preferences, key-value state, or relational records such as alarms, goals, steps, and reminder schedules; Notification Kit consumes that stored state to publish local notifications, badge updates, or progress notifications when the app logic determines an alert or update is needed.

compositions.name: 应用界面国际化 / Localized App UI
when: 我想让应用根据系统语言显示不同文案 / I want the app to show different text based on the system language
需要在 ArkUI 页面中接入多语言资源 / Need to use multilingual resources in ArkUI pages
应用启动后按用户区域设置渲染本地化界面 / Render a localized UI after app launch according to the user locale
给 UIAbility 应用添加国际化和本地化支持 / Add i18n and l10n support to a UIAbility app
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the app lifecycle entry through AbilityStage/UIAbility, Localization Kit supplies locale-aware resources and formatting, and ArkUI consumes those localized strings or values to render declarative pages and update UI state when locale-related data changes.

compositions.name: 媒体播放服务卡片 / Media Playback Widget
when: 我想做一个桌面音乐播放卡片，可以显示歌曲并控制播放 / I want to build a home-screen music widget that shows the current track and controls playback
需要在锁屏卡片上展示音频播放状态 / I need to display audio playback status on a lock-screen card
做一个音乐 App 的服务卡片，点击后打开应用并继续播放 / Build a music app service widget that opens the app and continues playback when tapped
希望用 ArkTS 卡片展示媒体内容并和播放器联动 / I want an ArkTS widget that presents media content and stays in sync with the player
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the application and UIAbility lifecycle entry points, Form Kit renders the desktop or lock-screen service card UI, and Media Kit manages audio/video playback state; playback metadata and controls flow between the Media Kit player and the Form Kit card, while Ability Kit opens or resumes the full app when the card is interacted with.

compositions.name: 后台提醒与任务通知 / Background Reminders and Task Notifications
when: 我想在后台定时触发闹钟、习惯或健康提醒，并弹出本地通知 / I want to trigger alarms, habits, or health reminders in the background and show local notifications
应用退到后台后仍需执行延迟任务，完成时通知用户 / I need delayed tasks to run after the app goes to the background and notify the user when finished
需要用长时或短时后台任务维持处理，并通过通知显示状态或进度 / I need long-running or short background tasks to keep processing and display status or progress through notifications
想实现后台计划任务，到点后更新角标或发送提醒通知 / I want scheduled background tasks that update badges or send reminder notifications when due
compositions.notes: Background Tasks Kit schedules or runs short, long-running, or delayed work while the app is not foregrounded, then Notification Kit consumes the task result or timing event to publish local notifications, badge updates, or progress notifications to the user.

compositions.name: 跨设备分布式界面协同 / Cross-Device Distributed UI Collaboration
when: 需要在应用界面中发现并连接附近设备 / Need to discover and connect nearby devices from the app UI
想把当前页面或业务能力拉起到另一台设备上 / Want to launch the current page or capability on another device
需要做手机、平板等设备间的分布式新闻或内容浏览体验 / Need a distributed news or content browsing experience across phone, tablet, and other devices
希望通过 UIAbility 连接实现跨设备协同操作 / Want to use UIAbility connection for cross-device collaborative operations
compositions.notes: ArkUI builds the interactive pages and state-driven controls for selecting devices and triggering actions, while Distributed Service Kit provides device management and cross-device UIAbility connection. The user action starts in ArkUI, selected device or ability parameters are passed to Distributed Service Kit, and connection or launch results are reflected back in the UI.

compositions.name: 带预检请求的网页容器 / Web Container with Preflight Networking
when: 我想先用 HTTP 检查接口或拿到配置，再加载 Web 页面 / I want to check an API or fetch config via HTTP before loading a Web page
应用里需要嵌入网页，并把网络请求结果展示到页面或传给 JS / I need to embed a Web page and pass network results to the page or JavaScript
我要做一个支持 HTTPS 请求验证的 WebView 示例 / I want to build a WebView sample that validates HTTPS requests
页面加载前需要通过网络获取 URL、Token 或业务数据 / Before loading the page, I need to fetch the URL, token, or business data from the network
compositions.notes: ArkUI builds the declarative screen and hosts the Web component; Network Kit performs HTTP/WebSocket/Socket/DNS requests to fetch or verify remote data, then ArkWeb loads the target page and can exchange the fetched results with JavaScript in the Web content.

compositions.name: 持久化提醒与后台通知 / Persistent Reminders with Background Notifications
when: 我想保存用户设置的闹钟或健康提醒，并在后台到点通知 / I want to save user-configured alarms or health reminders and notify at the right time in the background
需要把提醒计划持久化，应用不在前台时也能触发本地通知 / Need to persist reminder schedules and trigger local notifications even when the app is not in the foreground
如何实现可恢复的定时提醒、延迟任务和通知角标 / How to implement recoverable timed reminders, deferred tasks, and notification badges
我要用数据库记录任务状态，再由后台任务更新进度通知 / I want to record task state in a database, then update progress notifications from a background task
compositions.notes: ArkData persists reminder/task definitions, user preferences, and execution state; Background Tasks reads that stored data to run short, long, or deferred work at the appropriate time; Notification Kit then publishes local notifications, badge changes, or progress notifications based on the background task result.

compositions.name: 相册图片编辑与保存 / Album Image Editing and Save
when: 从系统相册选择一张照片，裁剪或处理后保存回相册 / Select a photo from the system album, crop or process it, then save it back to the album
做一个图片编辑器，能读取相册图片、修改像素或EXIF并导出文件 / Build an image editor that reads album photos, modifies pixels or EXIF, and exports a file
把用户相册里的照片解码编辑后，保存到应用沙箱用于后续上传 / Decode and edit photos from the user album, then save them to the app sandbox for later upload
实现照片管理中的编辑功能：选图、处理、生成新图片 / Implement an edit feature in photo management: pick an image, process it, and generate a new image
compositions.notes: Media Library Kit provides access to user albums and photo assets, Image Kit decodes the selected image, performs image processing/editing and EXIF handling, and Core File Kit stores the edited result as an app/user file or provides the file data that can be written back through the media library.

compositions.name: 定位界面与位置更新 / Location UI with Position Updates
when: 我想在应用页面显示用户当前位置并持续更新 / I want to show the user's current location on an app page and keep it updated
需要在 UIAbility 中申请并使用定位能力，然后把结果展示到 ArkUI 页面 / I need to use location in a UIAbility and display the result in an ArkUI page
构建一个包含定位、逆地理编码结果展示的 HarmonyOS 页面 / Build a HarmonyOS page that shows location and reverse-geocoding results
应用启动后进入页面获取 GNSS/定位信息并刷新界面状态 / After app launch, enter a page, obtain GNSS/location data, and refresh UI state
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the application and UIAbility lifecycle entry, Location Kit obtains location/GNSS data or reverse-geocoded address information, and ArkUI consumes that data through component state to render and update the interface.

compositions.name: 计步传感器界面 / Pedometer Sensor UI
when: 我想做一个计步器页面，实时读取运动传感器并更新界面 / I want to build a pedometer screen that reads motion sensors in real time and updates the UI
需要在 HarmonyOS 应用中展示步数或运动状态，并在达到条件时触发振动 / I need to show step count or motion status in a HarmonyOS app and trigger vibration when conditions are met
如何把传感器数据接入 ArkUI 组件做实时运动监测 / How can I connect sensor data to ArkUI components for real-time motion monitoring
我要开发一个基于加速度或陀螺仪的运动检测应用 / I want to develop a motion-detection app based on accelerometer or gyroscope data
compositions.notes: Ability Kit starts and manages the application lifecycle, Sensor Service Kit provides accelerometer/gyroscope readings and optional vibration feedback, and ArkUI consumes the sensor state to render and update the declarative UI. The data flow is lifecycle entry -> subscribe to sensor events -> update UI state -> optionally invoke vibration based on sensor-derived conditions.

compositions.name: 自定义文本输入与键盘接入 / Custom Text Input and Keyboard Integration
when: 我想在应用里接入系统输入法并处理文本输入 / I want to integrate the system IME in my app and handle text input
需要为登录页、表单或搜索框提供键盘输入能力 / I need keyboard input for a login page, form, or search box
如何管理输入框焦点、弹出键盘和接收用户输入 / How can I manage text-field focus, show the keyboard, and receive user input
我要实现与 HarmonyOS 输入法框架兼容的文本输入体验 / I want to implement a text input experience compatible with the HarmonyOS IME framework
compositions.notes: ime-kit provides the IME framework connection for text fields, enabling the app to request keyboard display, receive composed/committed text, and manage input interaction between focused UI controls and the system keyboard.

compositions.name: 图片数据持久化展示 / Persistent Image Data Display
when: 我想把应用里的图片记录、标题和设置保存下来，并在页面中恢复显示 / I want to save image records, titles, and settings in the app and restore them in the UI
需要对图片做解码或读取EXIF后，把结果写入本地数据库或KV存储 / I need to decode images or read EXIF and then write the results to a local database or KV store
做一个带缩略图或封面图的列表，图片信息要可持久化并随应用启动加载 / Build a list with thumbnails or cover images whose image information is persisted and loaded on app startup
希望在ArkUI页面中展示经过处理的图片，同时保存处理状态和用户偏好 / I want to show processed images in ArkUI pages while saving processing state and user preferences
compositions.notes: Ability Kit starts the UIAbility lifecycle, ArkUI renders the image list/detail UI and state, Image Kit decodes/edits images and extracts EXIF or pixel information, ArkTS coordinates the async data models, and ArkData persists image paths, metadata, preferences, or relational records that are loaded back into the UI.

compositions.name: 媒体播放/录制历史与偏好管理 / Media Playback/Recording History and Preferences
when: 我想做一个音乐播放器，并保存播放列表、播放进度和用户偏好 / I want to build a music player that saves playlists, playback position, and user preferences
我需要录音或录屏功能，并把录制文件的元数据保存起来供列表展示 / I need audio or screen recording and want to persist recording metadata for list display
如何在 HarmonyOS 应用中播放音视频，同时用本地数据库管理媒体记录 / How can I play audio/video in a HarmonyOS app while managing media records in a local database
我要开发一个带最近播放、收藏和设置记忆的媒体应用 / I want to develop a media app with recent plays, favorites, and remembered settings
compositions.notes: Ability Kit starts the app lifecycle, ArkUI presents playback/recording controls and media lists, ArkTS implements the interaction logic, Media Kit produces or consumes media playback/recording state and file information, and ArkData persists preferences, KV data, or relational records such as playlists, progress, favorites, and recording metadata.

compositions.name: 后台刷新服务卡片 / Background-Refreshed Service Widget
when: 我想让桌面或锁屏卡片在应用退到后台后仍能定时更新数据 / I want a home-screen or lock-screen widget to keep updating data after the app goes to background
需要用后台任务刷新服务卡片上的健康、音乐或状态信息 / Need background tasks to refresh health, music, or status information shown on a service widget
应用不打开时也要维护卡片内容，例如播放状态、步数或提醒 / Maintain widget content such as playback state, steps, or reminders even when the app is not opened
实现一个 ArkTS 服务卡片，并通过短时、长时或延迟后台任务推送最新内容 / Build an ArkTS service widget and push fresh content through short, long, or deferred background tasks
compositions.notes: Ability Kit provides the application and UIAbility/Form lifecycle entry points, ArkTS implements the data and task logic, ArkUI renders the in-app and card UI, Background Tasks Kit runs scheduled or permitted work while the app is backgrounded, and Form Kit consumes the refreshed data to update desktop or lock-screen service cards.

compositions.name: 图片服务卡片 / Image-Driven Service Widget
when: 我想做一个桌面服务卡片，显示经过解码或裁剪的图片 / I want to build a home-screen service widget that displays decoded or cropped images
需要在锁屏卡片或桌面卡片中展示专辑封面、头像、海报等图片内容 / I need to show album art, avatars, posters, or similar images in a lock-screen or home-screen widget
如何用 ArkTS 创建带图片处理能力的服务卡片 / How can I create an ArkTS service widget with image processing support
想让应用能力提供卡片入口，并在卡片 UI 中渲染处理后的图片 / I want the app ability to provide a widget entry and render processed images in the widget UI
compositions.notes: Ability Kit defines the app and widget lifecycle entry, ArkTS implements the card logic, Image Kit decodes or transforms the source image data, and ArkUI renders the resulting pixels or image resource inside the Form Kit service card. Form Kit packages the ArkTS/ArkUI view as a desktop or lock-screen widget that consumes the image output prepared by Image Kit.

compositions.name: 本地化位置展示 / Localized Location Display
when: 我想获取用户当前位置并按用户语言显示地址 / I want to get the user's current location and display the address in the user's language
需要在应用中做定位并支持多语言界面 / Need location features in the app with a multilingual UI
根据用户所在位置显示本地化的地点信息 / Show localized place information based on the user's location
做一个运动或出行应用，定位结果要适配不同地区语言 / Build a fitness or travel app where location results adapt to different regional languages
compositions.notes: Ability Kit initializes the app entry and lifecycle, Location Kit obtains coordinates or reverse-geocoded location data, Localization Kit formats text/resources according to the user's locale, and ArkUI renders the localized location information in the interface.

compositions.name: 本地化计步器 / Localized Pedometer
when: 我想做一个根据系统语言显示步数和运动文案的计步应用 / I want to build a pedometer app that displays step counts and activity text in the system language
需要读取传感器步行动作并用多语言界面展示结果 / Need to read walking motion from sensors and show the results in a multilingual UI
开发一个支持国际化的运动计步页面 / Develop an internationalized fitness step-counting page
想在 HarmonyOS 应用中结合传感器数据和本地化资源 / I want to combine sensor data with localized resources in a HarmonyOS app
compositions.notes: ability-kit starts the UIAbility lifecycle, sensor-service-kit provides motion sensor data for step detection or activity updates, localization-kit formats user-facing strings and locale-specific text, and arkui renders the localized step-count UI and reacts to state changes. The data flows from sensors into app state, then through localized presentation resources into ArkUI components.

compositions.name: 定位计步与运动轨迹 / Location-Aware Step Tracking
when: 我想做一个计步器，同时记录用户当前位置或运动路线 / I want to build a pedometer that also records the user’s current location or walking route
需要在步行、跑步场景中结合传感器步数和定位信息 / I need to combine sensor-based step data with location information for walking or running scenarios
如何开发一个显示步数、距离和位置状态的运动应用 / How can I develop a fitness app that shows steps, distance, and location status
想根据用户移动和地理位置更新运动数据界面 / I want to update a fitness UI based on user movement and geographic position
compositions.notes: Ability Kit hosts the app lifecycle, ArkUI renders the step/location dashboard, Sensor Service Kit provides motion signals such as accelerometer or step-related sensor data, and Location Kit provides GNSS/location updates that can be combined with sensor data to display walking progress, distance, and position-aware activity status.

compositions.name: 本地化偏好与数据持久化 / Localized Preferences and Data Persistence
when: 我想保存用户设置，并根据系统语言显示对应文案 / I want to save user settings and display text according to the system language
需要在应用中持久化步数或配置，同时支持多语言界面 / Need to persist steps or configuration in the app while supporting a multilingual UI
如何把用户偏好存到本地，并在不同地区显示本地化内容 / How to store user preferences locally and show localized content for different regions
我要做一个卡片或应用，既能保存本地数据，又能按语言环境展示内容 / I want to build a card or app that stores local data and presents content based on locale
compositions.notes: ArkData persists user preferences, key-value data, or structured records locally, and Localization Kit reads the current locale and localized resources so the saved data or settings can be presented with language- and region-appropriate labels and formats.

compositions.name: 带封面处理的媒体播放 / Media Playback with Cover Image Processing
when: 我想做一个音乐播放器，播放音频时显示并处理专辑封面 / I want to build a music player that plays audio while displaying and processing album artwork
我需要一个视频播放器页面，能够加载视频并展示缩略图或封面图 / I need a video player page that loads video and shows thumbnails or cover images
我想在媒体播放应用中解码、裁剪或适配封面图片再显示到播放界面 / I want to decode, crop, or fit cover images before showing them in a media playback UI
我需要用 ArkUI 做音视频播放界面，并配合图片编解码处理封面资源 / I need to build an audio/video playback UI with ArkUI and process cover assets through image decoding
compositions.notes: ArkTS implements the playback and image-processing logic, ArkUI renders the player controls and cover/thumbnail UI, Image Kit decodes or edits cover images and metadata images, and Media Kit provides audio/video playback whose media state and assets drive the displayed image content.

compositions.name: 文件传输与本地归档 / File Transfer and Local Archiving
when: 我想把用户选择的文件压缩后上传，并在本地保存记录 / I want to compress user-selected files, upload them, and keep local records
需要下载服务端文件，保存到应用或用户文件目录，并支持后续管理 / Need to download server files, save them to app or user file storage, and manage them later
实现新闻稿附件的本地存储、压缩打包和上传发布 / Implement local storage, zip packaging, and upload for news-release attachments
需要在应用内管理文件，并通过复制路径或内容辅助分享和传输 / Need to manage files in-app and use copied paths or content to assist sharing and transfer
compositions.notes: Core File Kit manages app/user files and provides the local file locations or file handles, then Basic Services Kit compresses selected files or transfers them through upload/download and can use clipboard capabilities for copying related file text or paths.

compositions.name: 卡片联动通知 / Card-Driven Notifications
when: 我想在服务卡片上展示健康或任务状态，并在状态变化时发送本地通知 / I want to show health or task status on a service widget and send local notifications when it changes
需要桌面或锁屏卡片展示实时摘要，同时用通知提醒用户继续操作 / Need a home-screen or lock-screen card to show a live summary while notifications remind users to continue
如何让 ArkTS 卡片和通知角标一起提示未完成事项 / How can an ArkTS card and notification badge indicate unfinished items together
想做一个计步或习惯类卡片，并用进度条通知展示目标完成进度 / I want to build a step-count or habit card and use a progress notification to show goal completion
compositions.notes: Form Kit provides the service, home-screen, lock-screen, or ArkTS card UI for persistent glanceable status, and Notification Kit sends local notifications, badges, or progress notifications based on the same status updates surfaced by the card.

compositions.name: 输入法交互测试 / IME Interaction Testing
when: 我想测试自定义输入框在键盘弹出、收起和输入文本时的行为 / I want to test how custom input fields behave when the keyboard opens, closes, and enters text
需要为登录页的账号密码输入和软键盘交互编写 UI 自动化测试 / I need UI automation tests for account/password input and soft-keyboard interaction on a login page
我要验证文本输入组件在不同输入法状态下是否正确响应 / I want to verify that text input components respond correctly under different IME states
希望测试输入法触发的文本变更、焦点切换和提交动作 / I want to test text changes, focus switching, and submit actions triggered by the IME
compositions.notes: ime-kit provides IME and keyboard-driven text input events for fields, while test-kit drives unit or UI test cases that focus inputs, simulate/observe keyboard interaction, and assert the resulting text, focus, or submit state.

compositions.name: 后台数据同步服务卡片 / Background-Synced Service Widget
when: 我想做一个桌面卡片，能在后台定时更新并展示本地数据 / I want a home-screen widget that updates in the background and displays local data
需要健康、音乐或任务类卡片在应用不打开时刷新状态 / I need a health, music, or task widget to refresh status when the app is not opened
如何把后台任务获取或计算的数据保存后同步到服务卡片 / How can I save data fetched or computed by a background task and sync it to a service widget
想用本地数据库或 Preferences 驱动 ArkTS 服务卡片内容 / I want to drive ArkTS service widget content from a local database or Preferences
compositions.notes: Ability Kit hosts the app lifecycle, ArkTS implements the logic, ArkData persists widget state or records, Background Tasks Kit refreshes or prepares that data while the app is not foregrounded, and Form Kit consumes the stored data to render and update the service card UI built with ArkUI.

compositions.name: 数据驱动的图片服务卡片 / Data-driven Image Service Card
when: 我想做一个桌面服务卡片，展示应用内保存的图片、封面或状态数据 / I want to build a home-screen service card that shows saved images, covers, or app status data
需要把数据库或Preferences里的内容同步到卡片，并显示处理后的缩略图 / I need to sync database or Preferences data to a card and display processed thumbnails
我要为音乐、相册或资讯类应用做带封面图的桌面/锁屏卡片 / I want to create a home-screen or lock-screen card with cover images for a music, gallery, or news app

compositions.name: 跨进程音乐播放控制 / Cross-Process Music Playback Control

compositions.name: 后台封面图处理 / Background Artwork Processing

compositions.name: 网络文件下载与本地缓存 / Network File Download and Local Cache

compositions.name: 媒体库记录管理 / Media Library Record Management

compositions.name: 网页图片处理与展示 / Web Image Processing and Display

compositions.name: 网页选择联系人 / Web Contact Selection

compositions.name: 后台媒体封面与状态持久化 / Background Media Artwork and State Persistence

compositions.name: 媒体会话播放控制 / Media Session Playback Control

compositions.name: 跨进程持久化播放数据 / Cross-process Persistent Playback Data

compositions.name: 定位数据持久化 / Location Data Persistence

compositions.name: 网络数据同步与本地缓存 / Network Data Sync with Local Cache

compositions.name: 本地计步与运动数据记录 / Local Pedometer and Motion Data Logging

when: 我想在应用内加载网页，并把关键内容做成桌面服务卡片 / I want to load web pages in the app and expose key content as a home-screen service card
需要一个 Web 组件展示 H5 内容，同时支持本地文件缓存和卡片入口 / I need a Web component for H5 content with local file caching and a card entry point

compositions.notes: Ability Kit starts the UIAbility, ArkUI hosts the ArkWeb Web component, ArkWeb loads the page and exchanges image data or file references with JavaScript, ArkTS coordinates the calls, Core File Kit reads/writes the image files, and Image Kit decodes, edits, or extracts metadata before the result is returned to the web UI.

compositions.name: 离线网页资源缓存与加载 / Offline Web Resource Caching and Loading
when: 我想在应用里加载网页，并把下载的 HTML/CSS/JS 资源缓存到本地以便离线访问 / I want to load web pages in the app and cache downloaded HTML/CSS/JS resources locally for offline access
